source: The Solar System master prompt (docs/SOLAR-SYSTEM.md), Part 1 section 1.7, turned into one record per level with the card fields of section 1.8. Cross-references (connects, payoff.metrics, grade) are computed from data/recipes.json by the build script, never typed.
confidenceNote: A registry of questions, not a measurement. The minutes are rough costs to enter. The grade is a default priority (S: load-bearing per A5; A: feeds four or more metrics; B: one to three; C: none) that the engine re-ranks per household.
note: Six planets, thirty levels each, ten bands of three. tag: E enter, C confirm, S sharpen. fields[] are the facts a level collects: a key that is an ownership field id (existing: true) migrates from the Ledger row named in row; a new key is stored under levels.<planet>.<key>. appliesWhen is one of the situations phrases; a failing level is absent, never greyed, and the planet's maximum shrinks. prefillFrom names the levels a C level reads, each in the same or a lower band (lint). payoff.metrics are the recipes this level completes in its own band; payoff.lever (bands 8 to 10) is the data/levers.json lever the level adds to the sun. credit: true marks the Debt & Credit levels that never drop out. nextMove resolves in data/moves.json. No level exists to fill a slot (1.2).
